sopKnowledge: At the beginning of the activity, SAP software exists in idle state with schedule_grid in unfocused_0 state, status_panel in unread_0 state, and location_field in unverified_0 state.
QAD Adaptive ERP exists in idle state with erp_schedule_grid in unfocused_0 state and distribution_panel in unread_0 state.
SCM scheduling data feed provides Scheduling and delivery data in JSON format.
ERP scheduling XML feed provides Scheduling and parts data in XML format.
desktop computer provides monitor_screen for observe software output.
computer keyboard provides enter_key, tab_key, and numeric_key for schedule entry.
computer mouse provides left_mouse_button, right_mouse_button, and scroll_wheel for selection and navigation.
Production, Planning, and Expediting Clerk uses frontal_lobe for coordinate scheduling decisions.
